items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I brought in old Big Boy.

ctx.x: And I came home and told Zutty. I said, you see, God works in a mysterious way. He was putting in charges and Zutty would have had to pay him for the two weeks whether he worked or not. And he had the charges released and he went to work the next night. I think that's when you, I don't know who was brought in.
I brought in old Big Boy. Because Andy said, my God, he said, I didn't want you to, a piano player, but you brought me a piano mover. (LAUGHTER).
